text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from a day out with<n>Seeking the
Pearl, we come across a<n>street vendor.

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, welcome! Come and check<n>out my
wares! These extremely rare<n>aurora hanadama
necklaces are<n>made with genuine akoya pearls!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
They're incredibly rare even among<n>hanadama
pearls! And look at their<n>size! For a limited time
only, I'm<n>willing to part with them at a thirty<n>percent
discount, so they're only<n>100,000 yen apiece!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Why, did you say akoya pearls?!<n>Never in my days
did I think I'd come<n>across some here of all places!
I'll<n>take this one!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, what craftsmanship! These<n>are all so
exquisitely made!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh my, are you interested in these<n>pieces too?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, yes, they're absolutely<n>fascinating! This
shimmer, this luster...<n>Every accessory on display
has<n>clearly been very carefully handled!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
You've got a well trained eye, miss!<n>Yes,
everything you see here was<n>made from precious,
natural resou—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
They're the highest quality imitation<n>pearls I've
seen yet! A lot of care<n>was put into them, that's for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Ack! Um! No! These are...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, Seeking the<n>Pearl's father
was a jeweler. If she<n>says they're imitation pearls,
then<n>they must be fakes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The stunningly high-end finish on<n>them is really
something else. The<n>surface texture is so
consistent, and<n>you can really feel their heft.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And since they're imitation pearls,<n>they won't get
dirty or damaged<n>easily, making them good for
everyday use.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? Sounds like they're<n>quite versatile
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Their affordability makes it easy<n>to elevate
your fashion with fancy<n>jewelry that looks just like
the real<n>deal.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What a commendable heart! You're a<n>true friend of
the people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely love what you're doing<n>here! Though,
it's a shame they're<n>only knockoffs...

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: Um... ah, no, I... Well...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You should tailor your business to<n>better suit the
needs of your<n>customers! As a friend of the
masses, you should properly explore<n>the
possibilities of imitation fashion!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Th-the possibilities of imitation<n>fashion? The needs
of the people...

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
I see now. I've been wrong. Why did<n>I ever try to
scam people into<n>believing these were real?

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am! Allow me to adjust the price<n>of that
necklace! I'm reducing it down<n>to 1,500 yen!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Now how about this<n>for your
pitch? "Mind-bogglingly low<n>prices! Imitation pearl
accessories<n>that'll make anyone dazzle with
effortless ease!"

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's great! Forget scamming<n>people! I'm
going to become a true<n>friend of the people and
make honest<n>coin out of my wares from now on!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
I think I will take this necklace after<n>all. It's really
quite a steal for the<n>quality. And it'll make all my
friends<n>so jealous!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Now that's what makes<n>imitation
accessories so appealing.<n>We should spread the
word<n>somehow. What do you think would<n>be the
best way to promote it?
choice_data_list: Highlight the unique features of imitation jewelry!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense... there are a lot of<n>students in
the area. I'm sure a lot of<n>them would love a fancy
new<n>accessory on a budget!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, girls! How about trying out<n>some
imitation pearl accessories?<n>Indulge in some
high-class fashion at<n>minimal cost!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, pearls? Are they actually that<n>affordable? My
allowance isn't that<n>big...

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Wow! There's loads of cute ones!<n>They've even
got earrings for just<n>500 yen!

text_block_list.name: Flashy Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are those pearls?! Look at this<n>bracelet! It's
so bougie!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! They're a total a hit, just like<n>we were
hoping! I see a pearl craze<n>on the horizon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the street vendor's store<n>flourishes thanks
to word-of-mouth<n>among students.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Good idea. I suppose we<n>could talk up how
versatile they are.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's try to develop a new<n>product!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: How about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Simply amazing! It'll sell like<n>hotcakes, no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Seeking the Pearl's creativity<n>and the street
vendor's<n>craftsmanship, the two create
flower-shaped beads with the<n>imitation pearls.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just change the fittings, and you've<n>got an
unparalleled four-in-one<n>accessory that can be
worn as a<n>necklace, earring, brooch, or<n>keychain!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
My goodness! How wonderful! I'll<n>take that one
too!

text_block_list.name: Street Vendor
text_block_list.text: R-right away, ma'am! Thank you very<n>much!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Lady
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. I really lucked out on all the<n>bargains I
nabbed today. I'm going to<n>tell my neighbors all
about this place!<n>♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, seems like we have a satisfied<n>customer!
Let's keep it up and win<n>over even more people!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, everyone! Check out our<n>super unique
four-in-one fashion<n>pearls! They're affordable,
stylish,<n>and super versatile!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after, the four-in-one imitation<n>pearl
accessories surge in popularity<n>thanks to the first
customer spreading<n>the word, and they quickly
becoming<n>the street vendor's top-selling item.
